task: Change the global keyboard Talk shortcut from Enter to Space, with speech consuming the press so Space never also fires a world interact action.
requirements: src/systems/speech.js PressToTalk: the keyboard shortcut is Space (event.code === 'Space' or event.key === ' '). Enter no longer starts, cancels or is consumed by speech.
Press once starts recognition; releasing Space does nothing to recognition; a second Space press while listening cancels (existing cancel({ notify: true }) path). Never hold-to-talk.

Consume (preventDefault + stopImmediatePropagation) a Space keydown ONLY when speech handled it: recognition started, an active session was cancelled, a start attempt failed into the unavailable/fallback path, or the mic-free fallback opened. A press refused by onPress (no target, target already accepted, game refused commit) must NOT be consumed, so the game's world interact (src/systems/input.js, window bubble listener) still receives it.

Contract: onPress may return false (refused, not handled), true (start recognition) or the string 'handled' (consumed without a microphone). createSpeechSystem's onPress returns 'handled' after target.onFallback() in mic-free mode. _press() returns whether the press was handled.

After a consumed Space keydown, also consume that key's auto-repeat keydowns and its keyup (PressToTalk adds a capture keyup listener on window; remove it in dispose). This swallowing continues until keyup even if the prompt is disabled mid-hold, so a held Space cannot reach input.js as a fresh press, and a focused button cannot synthesize a click from it.
Unconsumed repeats and keyups pass through untouched.

src/systems/speechPrompt.js promptSpeech: onCommit must return the caller's onCommit result (currently it drops it, so a Restaurant refusal still opens the mic). Keep the isActive guard: when inactive return false.
src/ui/hud.js: the talk key label shows 'Space' instead of 'Enter'.

src/systems/speech.test.mjs: replace the Enter test. Cover: Enter does not start speech; Space starts Talk and its keydown is defaultPrevented; Space keyup does not stop recognition; a second Space cancels an active session; a Space press with no enabled target / an accepted target / a refused commit is NOT defaultPrevented; repeat and keyup after a consumed press are defaultPrevented; mic-free fallback press is consumed. The FakeTarget helper may need a stopped flag on events.
